SQLite public-domain notice

Upstream: https://www.sqlite.org/
Authoritative statement: https://www.sqlite.org/copyright.html

SQLite's authors have dedicated its deliverable code and documentation to the
public domain. The original SQLite library may be used, modified and distributed
as source or compiled code, including in commercial applications, without a
license from SQLite.

This file records upstream's public-domain status for dependency provenance;
it does not impose additional terms or relicense SQLite under Simplex's license.
The original notices remain in the locally obtained SQLite source files.

Upstream distinguishes its deliverable library from some build scripts that
may have separate licenses. This dependency uses the amalgamation distribution;
this notice does not make claims about separately obtained scripts or extensions.
